record.title: Validate the full452-store stock ADC initialization region
record.intent: Falsify the complete static ADC prediction and identify the next environmental ambiguity.
requirements: Use the controlled executable, pinned full452-word transcript, fresh guest and unchanged stock APK/library.
Verify live table/function/shadow GOT bindings and all111 words of each source table against the pinned ELF before completing the first modeled write.
Require the initialized ADC index9/index8 software shadows used by the tail prediction; capture them initially and after terminal quiescence.
Permit only the existing two read responses and exact452-word ordered main-thread W32 program at the witnessed instruction and offset0x3000.
Stop immediately on mismatch, other access, signal or bound. After452 stores stop at the following access without answering it; predicted next offset0x1000 is not assumed.
Capture runtime thread events, terminal state, available SPU shadow bindings/values for the next static region, and exact cleanup or an explicit negative with partial evidence.
Do not adapt the fixture during this experiment; no physical ADC, ready, timing, DMA or acquisition claim.
Commit and push the conclusion before a successor experiment.
acceptance: Verify completed prefix and live inputs against independent derivation, report the next dependency and distinguish observation from predicted call order.

review.rationale: Revised OPEN task now validates the complete452-store ADC region with live inputs, software state and immediate divergence stop. Historic identifier is retained. No stock run or completion is asserted; private controls remain a prerequisite.
